about: My work spans applications of LLMs and building trust in ML systems. Earlier research took me through robotics, neuroscience, and group robustness, and I've spent several years building production ML/NLP systems in industry as well.

details: Research on incorporating fairness in machine learning, advised by Professor Hanghang Tong.
Explainable methods using LLMs over knowledge graphs, with Lihui Liu (lab alumna, now assistant professor at Wayne State University), advised by Professor Hanghang Tong.
Investigated the utility of living neurons for computation as part of an NSF Expedition in Computing project, focused on reservoir computing, advised by Professor Nancy Amato.
Motion-planning research with a focus on local planners, advised by Professor Nancy Amato.
Built eye-tracking hardware and ran VOR gain-up training to study gain consolidation after vestibular stimulation in mouse models.
Wrote tools to compare and manipulate neural and behavioral signals from SpikeGLX and Spike2 files.
Worked with Professor Jennifer Raymond and postdoc Trace Stay.
Investigated the effect of widely-used vision models and augmentation techniques on model robustness under distributional shift.
Researched worst-case generalization with low-count subgroups, advised by Professor Joseph E. Gonzalez and Professor Jacob Steinhardt.
ML linguistics research on efficient speech classification, transcribing audio to IPA representation in Python.
Presented at the end-of-year symposium.
Used Bayesian optimization to optimize data mix for fine-tuning Llama models, with Hakan Inan.

Built Q&A over RAG with LLMs across the full stack: ingestion of docs, Slack/Discord chats and JIRA tickets, retrieval, re-ranking, citation, and surfacing results in chat interfaces on docs sites, ticketing tools, and messaging platforms.
Startup founded by Professor Joseph Gonzalez and RISE Lab alumni; additionally advised by board member Professor Joseph Hellerstein.
Used by MotherDuck, Anyscale, Databricks, and others.
Prototyped and led development of a stethoscope-based telehealth product with ML anomaly detection and preliminary diagnosis.
First place, Pitt Challenge Hackathon 2021; alumna of the Ascender Incubator and LifeX Accelerator.

professional_experience.org: UC Berkeley Division of Data Science
details: Led a 7-person infrastructure team on an application-tracking and auto-grading system used across UC Berkeley courses and programs.
Built a custom admin dashboard; full-stack Django + PostgreSQL deployed on Azure App Services; CI with GitHub Actions, unittest, and Selenium.
Applied NLP techniques to resumes to auto-generate heuristic strengthening suggestions.
Backend-focused full-stack work in Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, S3, Google OAuth, Redis, Docker.
SkyDeck Accelerator HotDesk Fall 2020 cohort (<6% acceptance); Dean's Seed Fund Grant; Jack Larson Fellowship.
Applied NLP techniques to news articles to extract insights and summaries with Python, Amazon Comprehend, SQL Server, and Docker.
